description: Read the complete design profile of an open document or of an .indd/.indt/.idml file in one call, to explain it, check it or set new articles by it. Returns profile with document (page size, facing pages, page and spread count, binding, bleed_mm, slug_mm (Infobereich), sections, new_page_margins_mm), baseline_grid (start_mm, increment_mm, increment_pt, relative_to, shown – as get_layout_grid), parent_pages[] (Musterseiten: name, prefix, based_on, per page side, margins_mm, column_count, column_gutter_mm, column_width_mm, type_area_mm (Satzspiegel), columns_positions_mm, baseline_grid_check, used_by_pages and objects – page numbers, running heads, frames, lines – in the format of read_layout), pages[] (name, parent, side, margins_differ_from_parent), paragraph_styles[] with every value resolved through based_on (font, size, leading, tracking, alignment, spaces, indents and tab_stops, align_to_baseline_grid, language, hyphenation_options, justification_options, keep_options, drop_cap, paragraph_rules above/below, span_columns, capitalization, position, underline, strikethrough, baseline_shift_pt, shading, border, list_type, next_style, counts of nested/line/GREP styles), character_styles[] (only the values the style sets, others null), object_styles[] (enabled categories, fill, stroke, corner, paragraph_style, text_frame, text_wrap), table_styles, cell_styles, swatches[] (colour model and values, tints, gradients), layers[], fonts[] (status, used_by_styles) and usage (unused styles and parent pages). Every style carries usage {paragraphs or ranges/characters or objects, pages, parent_pages}: how often it is used and on which pages (the pages of the frames holding the story). Measures in mm, type sizes and spaces before/after in pt. format markdown adds summary, a readable overview with tables; output_path writes the profile as JSON (and the summary next to it as .md); the answer then carries counts and summary only unless include_profile is true. The profile of a magazine is several hundred kB: for a long document pass output_path. all_attributes true adds attributes, every resolved IDML value of each style. Read-only for the document.

all_attributes.description: Add attributes, every resolved IDML value, to each paragraph, character and object style. Default false.

document_id.description: Document to read, from list_documents or open_document. Without it (and without path) the frontmost document is used.

format.description: json (default): the profile; markdown: a readable summary instead; both: profile and summary.

include_parent_objects.description: Objects of the parent pages (page numbers, running heads, frames, lines) under parent_pages[].objects and their texts as parent_stories. Default true.

include_profile.description: Return the profile in the answer. Default true without output_path (format json or both), false with it.

output_path.description: Write the profile to this .json file; with format markdown or both the summary goes next to it as .md.

path.description: An .idml, .indd or .indt file to read instead of an open document. An .idml is read without InDesign; an .indd/.indt is opened as an invisible copy and closed again.

name: read_document_profile
title: Read the document profile
